en.prefs.geometry_kernel_environment: The SOLIDCRAFT_KERNEL environment variable is set; it wins over this setting.
en.prefs.geometry_kernel_note: solidcore, the default, answers every operation. Choose SMLib for the C++ kernel. A solidcore failure is reported, never retried on SMLib.
en.prefs.geometry_kernel_unavailable: SMLib is not available in this build. Operations run on solidcore.
